summary: Iteration 10 - Frontend redesign migration testing complete. All public pages (Home, About, Services, Tools, Community, Contact), Login, Register, and Dashboard tested. Public Navigation (sticky+blur) and Footer wrapping works correctly on all 8 public routes. Dashboard untouched and renders correctly post-login. GSAP, FootballPitchCanvas, dynamic backend pricing (/api/packages), and dynamic events (/api/events) all functioning. No blocker bugs.

minor.issue: DB contains 2 duplicate TEST_Premium Package entries (Rp 150.000) from prior iterations. Services page renders 4 prices but slot 4 ends up Rp 150.000 instead of the seeded Pro Yearly Rp 399.000 due to ordering. Cleanup recommended.

action_items: (Optional) Clean up duplicate TEST_Premium Package documents in MongoDB so Services page shows Pro Yearly (Rp 399k) in 4th slot instead of duplicate test data.
(Optional) Suppress 401 console error from /api/auth/me when user is unauthenticated on public pages — currently throws 18 noisy 401s on initial load. Functionally harmless.
critical_code_review_comments: Spec mentions hero-cta and hero-secondary-cta data-testids, but Home.js uses home-explore-cta and home-learn-cta — both equivalent and present, just naming difference vs spec
Subject field on Contact form is a <select> (not <input>), so spec wording 'contact-subject' as text input is slightly misleading; works fine, just note for tests

Contact form validation correctly shows red 'wajib diisi' error texts on empty submit. Use red text for these errors — selector to grab them is text-content, not .error class (no .error CSS class used). Acceptable.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public site redesign verified end-to-end. Sticky nav blur on scroll: PASS. Mobile hamburger fullscreen overlay: PASS. All 6 nav links navigate. /api/packages returns 4 packages (Starter, 2 TEST_Premium dupes, Pro Yearly). /api/events returns 2 events. Dashboard untouched, renders with sidebar after login. Login&Register wrapped in PublicLayout (nav+footer visible). Note: Preloader gated by sessionStorage 'itz_preloaded' flag — only shows on first / visit per session.
